test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Phad, an art form of Rajasthan, is a ________ form of painting.
solution:
The correct answer is __**religious**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Phad Painting **is **practised in Rajasthan**.
 
• It is a **style of painting **in which **scroll painting **and **folk painting **is done on **a canvas or a long cloth, termed as 'phad**'.
 
• **Generally**, the **narratives of the folk deities **of the state are depicted in this **style of painting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The famous Madhubani **paintings **belong to the Indian state of Bihar**.
 
• **Kalighat paintings **originated in the **vicinity of Kalighat Kali Temple, Kalighat, Kolkata.**
 
• **Madhubani Paintings originated **from the **Madhubani district, Mithila region of Bihar**.
 
• **Kalamkari originated in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.**
